chunks: Except Iblis. He refused to be with the prostrators.

key_terms.إِبْلِيسَ: Iblis (Satan), the jinn who refused to bow to Adam
key_terms.السَّاجِدِينَ: The prostrators (those who bowed in worship)

ai.seo_question: Why did Iblis refuse to prostrate to Adam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the distinction between Iblis, who was of the Jinn and not an angel, and the angels, highlighting his pride in refusing to prostrate to Adam as the first act of disobedience. This event establishes the theological basis for Iblis's enmity towards humanity and his role as the clear deceiver, a theme central to the concept of fitrah and the test of free will.
